    # Separator color appears as full horizontal/vertical lines. Each tile
    # containing an orthogonally adjacent pair of non-background marks is highlighted.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((v for v in range(10) if all(x == v for x in grid[0])), None)
    if sep is None:
        return grid
    bg = next((v for v in range(10) if v != sep and sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) > 0), None)
    # The most common non-separator color is the tile background.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark = next((v for v in counts if v != bg), None)
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if not all(x == sep for x in grid[i])]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if not all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    # Split into contiguous runs outside separator lines/columns.
    def runs(indices):

            else:

        return out

    result = [[bg for _ in cc] for _ in rr]
